title: The principal wants gift cards
scenario: An email from the principal’s display name asks you to buy gift cards for student awards before a meeting. It says the school will reimburse you and asks for the card numbers by reply.

answers.A: Verify the request with the principal or school office through a known channel before purchasing anything.
answers.B: Ask the sender to submit the request through the school’s normal purchasing process.
answers.C: Buy the cards but keep the codes until the principal confirms in person.

explanation: Authority and a helpful mission can bypass skepticism. Normal procurement controls are the stronger signal.
proTip: Urgent generosity still needs normal controls.
